title: Vibe Coding: A Practical Guide to Context-Engineered Prototyping
description: A workshop introducing Vibe Coding, a method for designing AI interactions that preserve cultural, emotional, and experiential context. Presents the VIBE Loop (Value, Intent, Boundaries, Expression), context-engineered prompting, rapid prototyping, and security and responsible-AI considerations for building human-aligned AI systems. Presented at the UCF Institute of Artificial Intelligence Workshop.
